```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Compute HIGH VTE alarm
    Given the current breath VTE is above the threshold
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the HIGH VTE alarm is active

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm priority
    Given the current breath VTE is below the threshold
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the LOW VTE alarm has medium priority

  Scenario: HIGH VTE alarm priority
    Given the current breath VTE is above the threshold
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the HIGH VTE alarm has medium priority

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath
    Given multiple breaths with varying VTE values
    When the GUI computes the VTE for each breath
    Then the VTE is correctly calculated for each breath

  Scenario: Cancelled pressure high alarm
    Given the pressure high alarm is triggered
    When the alarm is cancelled
    Then the alarm does not re-trigger for 2 minutes

  Scenario: High-priority alarm for O2 input line disconnection
    Given the O2 input line is disconnected
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then a high-priority alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Display all active alarms
    Given multiple alarms are triggered
    When the GUI displays the active alarms
    Then all active alarms are displayed

  Scenario: Event log includes confirmed alarm settings
    Given multiple alarms are triggered and confirmed
    When the event log is reviewed
    Then all confirmed alarm settings are included in the event log

  Scenario Outline: VTE threshold boundaries
    Given the current breath VTE is <VTE>
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the alarm is <alarm_status>

    Examples:
      | VTE | alarm_status |
      | 0   | not triggered |
      | 1   | triggered     |
      | 100 | triggered     |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid VTE values
    Given the current breath VTE is <VTE>
    When the GUI computes the alarm
    Then the alarm is <alarm_status>

    Examples:
      | VTE | alarm_status |
      | -1  | not triggered |
      | 101 | not triggered |

  Scenario: 2-minute suppression timing
    Given the pressure high alarm is triggered and cancelled
    When the alarm is re-triggered
    Then the alarm is not triggered for 2 minutes

  Scenario: Event log structure and timestamps
    Given multiple alarms are triggered and confirmed
    When the event log is reviewed
    Then the event log includes correct structure and timestamps
```
